concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly requires 'Statistical summarization: perform paired t-tests or Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on the collection of metric differences to assess overall superiority of any method.' No FR or SC covers this cross-method comparison; the spec only aggregates means/SDs (US-2 scenario 3). Add an FR for paired significance testing of per-method metric differences.

Under-reach: the idea requires 'marginal PDFs (via kernel density estimates)' and visualization artifacts ('side-by-side histograms, QQ-plots, and correlation heatmaps'). The spec computes KS/Chi-square statistics but drops KDE-based marginal comparison and all visualization outputs. Either add these or explicitly scope them out in Assumptions.

Under-reach (minor): the idea's preprocessing includes 'standardize numerics, and split into train/hold-out sets.' FR-001 covers imputation and encoding only; the train/hold-out split is absent. If the hold-out is intentionally dropped (synthetic data compared against training set), state this as an explicit assumption; otherwise add it.

Under-reach (minor): the idea specifies DP-GAN as 'privacy-budget-controlled'; FR-002 trains all three models with 'default hyperparameters' with no privacy-budget (epsilon) setting or recording. Clarify whether the DP budget is configured and reported, since it affects interpretability of DP-GAN's divergence.
